title: Taxes Paid by Jurisdiction Threshold Calculator
description: Computes each jurisdiction's share of total income taxes paid net of refunds received and flags the jurisdictions that reach ASU 2023-09's individual-disaggregation threshold of 5 percent (ASC 740-10-50-23). The comparison is made between the absolute value of each jurisdiction's net payment or net refund and the absolute value of the total, so a jurisdiction in a net refund position is measured by the size of that refund. Also reports the federal, state and foreign subtotals that ASC 740-10-50-22 requires regardless of any threshold. Verify-only: it reports shares computed from declared inputs and never asserts that a disclosure requirement has been met.

jurisdictions.description: One entry per jurisdiction in which income taxes were paid or recovered during the period. Rows naming the same jurisdiction and tier are combined before the share is computed.

jurisdiction.description: Country, state or local territory identified as an individual jurisdiction

tier.description: Drives the ASC 740-10-50-22 federal, state and foreign subtotals. Defaults to foreign when absent.

amount.description: Income taxes paid net of refunds received. Negative denotes a net refund position.

declared_total.description: Total income taxes paid net of refunds received, used as the denominator when supplied. Null uses the sum of the jurisdiction rows. A supplied total is reconciled against the row sum and the difference is reported rather than absorbed.

threshold_pct.description: Individual-jurisdiction disaggregation threshold as a percentage of total income taxes paid net of refunds. ASU 2023-09 states 5. Any other value is a sensitivity check and is flagged as not reflecting the standard.

jurisdictions.description: Every assessed jurisdiction, flagged first then ranked by share descending

category_subtotals.description: Federal, state and foreign subtotals required by ASC 740-10-50-22 regardless of any threshold

caveats.description: Named conditions that affect how the result should be read, such as a zero or near-zero denominator, a reconciliation difference, or a non-standard threshold

mcp_tool_definition.name: calc_taxes_paid_jurisdiction_threshold
mcp_tool_definition.description: Computes each jurisdiction's share of total income taxes paid net of refunds received and flags which jurisdictions reach the ASU 2023-09 individual-disaggregation threshold of 5 percent, comparing absolute values on both sides. Also returns the federal, state and foreign subtotals required regardless of threshold. Browser-based, client-side only, zero PII.

jurisdictions.description: Rows of jurisdiction, tier and income taxes paid net of refunds received

declared_total.description: Total income taxes paid net of refunds, used as the denominator when supplied

regulatory_citations: ASC 740-10-50-22 (income taxes paid net of refunds received, disaggregated by federal, state and foreign)
ASC 740-10-50-23 (individual jurisdiction equal to or greater than 5 percent of total income taxes paid net of refunds received)
